info.title: Personio
info.description: Read, create, update, and delete Personio person records using the current v2 public API.

get.description:
- This endpoint returns a list of persons.
- The endpoint supports pagination and filtering based on various parameters such as id, first_name, last_name, created_at, and updated_at.
  - Filters are combined using the logical "AND" operator, which requires that all conditions be true for the output to be included.
- The endpoint requires the personio:persons:read scope.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The amount of resources to be returned per one request. It can range between 1 and 50, and the default is 10.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The pagination cursor to navigate over to the next list of resources. If you pass a specific limit to your  request, or you rely on the default value of the number of resources to be returned, then your subsequent call has to include the cursor in order to retrieve the next list of resources. If cursor is missing,  the first page is returned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter results matching one or more provided person ids.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Filter persons matching one or more provided email addresses

parameters.name: created_at.gt
parameters.description: Filter persons created after the provided date.

parameters.name: created_at.lt
parameters.description: Filter persons created before the provided date.

parameters.name: updated_at.gt
parameters.description: Filter persons updated after the provided date.

parameters.name: updated_at.lt
parameters.description: Filter persons updated before the provided date.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter persons by status. ACTIVE includes persons whose latest employment status is active, leave, or onboarding. INACTIVE includes persons whose latest employment status is inactive.

post.summary: Create a new Person and Employment.
post.description:
- This endpoint enables the creation of a Person resource and an associated Employment resource.
- The endpoint requires the personio:persons:write scope.

get.description: This endpoint returns a specific person identified by the ID parameter. The endpoint requires the personio:persons:read scope.

patch.description:
- This endpoint enables the update of a Person resource.
- The endpoint requires the personio:persons:write scope.

delete.description:
- This endpoint enables the deletion of a Person resource.
- The endpoint requires the personio:persons:write scope.

email.description: The email address this Person is connected with. The email is unique per Person, and the same Person can hold different Employments sharing the same email.

created_at.description: The timestamp of when the person was created in UTC

updated_at.description: The timestamp of when the person was updated in UTC

first_name.description: The first name of the person

last_name.description: The last name of the person

preferred_name.description: The preferred name of the person

url.description: The URL of the person's profile picture

status.description: The status of the person that is derived from the status of the latest person's employment. The person status will be set to ACTIVE if the current employment has ACTIVE, LEAVE or ONBOARDING status, otherwise the person status will be set to INACTIVE. Please use employment status to get more fine grained value for status.

label.description: The label defined for this attribute.

items.description: An arbitrary value that can be represented as a string.

employments.description: A list of ids of created Employments.

id.description: The id of the created Employment.

org_units.description: All Org Units, i.e. department and team, that are to be associated with the Employment.

id.description: The unique identifier for the `subcompany`. Note: this field is present only to support the mapping between subcompanies and legal entities. It is not advised to rely on this field. The legal entities should be used instead.
The unique identifier for the legal entity.

job.description: The `job` to be associated with the Employment.

contract_end_date.description: When the employment contract ends, if the contract is for temporary employment.

probation_end_date.description: When the probation period ends. Only one of probation_period_length or probation_end_date should be set.

probation_period_length.description: Only one of probation_period_length or probation_end_date should be set.

weekly_working_hours.description: The number of hours worked weekly.

full_time_weekly_working_hours.description: The number of hours per week that is considered full time for the employment.

cost_centers.description: The weight distribution of this employment between different cost centers, using percentages.

type.description: The type of the Org Unit, e.g. team or department, to be associated with the Employment.

id.description: The Internal ID of the Org Unit to be associated with the Employment.

CostCenter.description: A weight assigned to a Cost Center resource.

id.description: The unique identifier of the Cost Center.

weight.description: The weight in percentage assigned to this Cost Center. The total of all Cost Center weights must be 100.

email.description: Email of the employee. The email must be unique : 2+ employees cannot have the same email.

preferred_name.description: The preferred name of the employee, if relevant.
